$comment: Bounded, committed waiver for the Production E2E gate.
RULES ENFORCED BY scripts/e2e-gate.mjs (not by convention):
1. A waived test still RUNS. Nothing is skipped or deleted.
2. Past `expires`, the gate FAILS on the waiver itself. It cannot rot.
3. A waived test that starts PASSING fails the gate until it is removed
— unless it is marked `unstable`, which means it is waived precisely
because it flaps, so a green run proves nothing.
4. Any failure NOT listed here fails the gate normally.
5. The window is capped at 30 days and the policy path is hard-coded in
the script: no CLI override, no env var, no runtime widening.
Baseline: Production E2E had never been green — 0 successes in 405 runs
since 2026-05-17. main @ b2ee7c88 = 57 failed / 177 passed / 24 skipped.
This branch = 10-11 failed / 204-205 passed across consecutive runs.
The list below is the UNION of what failed across runs 31697185717 and
31698415663 on the same code, not the snapshot of one run: the failing
subset moves between runs, which is itself part of the finding. Entries are
grouped by root cause; each cluster needs one product answer, not fourteen

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:334:1 › authenticated user area applies the global platform design system
waived.reason: The IDE surface keeps rendering dark where the test expects light, even after seeding the ecode_theme cookie + localStorage and reloading so the server re-seeds <html data-theme>. Needs a product answer: is the IDE dark-only by design, or is light-theme plumbing broken on these surfaces?

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:744:1 › IDE applies the full 2026 color theme tokens
waived.reason: Same cluster: toMatchObject over the 2026 token set resolves to dark values.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:841:1 › IDE panels, agent input and feature tools keep the platform theme in light and dark modes
waived.reason: Same cluster; fails in some runs and passes in others on identical code.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1035:1 › all IDE service panels keep light theme containers readable
waived.reason: Reports 'X contains dark containers in light theme', and the offending panel changes between runs (git / packages / database / overview). Either several service panels genuinely ignore the light theme, or the assertion races the panel's theme application.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1141:1 › platform typography tokens apply to the web IDE
waived.reason: Typography probe runs against the IDE shell and inherits the same unresolved theme state.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1597:1 › IDE light theme tabs use visible tokenized surfaces
waived.reason: Expected 'light', received 'dark', even after forceLightTheme() (cookie + reload). Root cause is upstream of the test.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1224:1 › IDE applies section 12 UI detail styles
waived.reason: The add-tab palette never mounts in CI: [data-testid=ide-add-tab-command-palette] stays absent after its trigger is clicked, on a commit where the IDE shell itself renders fine. Not a locator problem.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1287:1 › IDE project services open as in-place panels instead of legacy project pages
tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:2011:1 › command palette entries navigate to real product routes
waived.reason: /command-palette renders its AppShell heading but the action links never appear, even with a 30s wait. The command list seems to depend on state the CI stack does not produce.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1891:1 › authenticated users can sign out from the app shell
waived.reason: Opening the account popover before clicking fixed the click, and this now passes in some runs. When it fails, the app stays on /dashboard instead of redirecting to /login — the POST /logout round-trip, not the click.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:1883:1 › billing upgrade flow is reachable without frontend-only quota bypass
waived.reason: Passed on main and on four consecutive branch runs, failed once. Not touched by this branch; tracked here so one flap does not red the gate.

waived.test: tests/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts:458:1 › opens preserved Bolt IDE route for a project
waived.reason: A computed `position` reads '' instead of 'relative' — the measured element is missing, not mis-styled. Needs the current IDE layout contract to rewrite against.

waived.test: tests/e2e/mobile-device-matrix.spec.ts:313:5 › compact IDE shell device matrix › adapts to iphone-se
waived.reason: 'nav visible expected true received false': the compact bottom nav intermittently fails to render. Hit 1 profile, then 5, then 1 across consecutive runs of the SAME commit. Should be diagnosed as a real race, not papered over with retries.

waived.test: tests/e2e/mobile-device-matrix.spec.ts:313:5 › compact IDE shell device matrix › adapts to ipad-mini-portrait
